description: Family 14 (docs/tasks.md section 17): the operator of a Cashu desk backed by Ark keeps users' value safe and liquid over a horizon of blocks. It admits deposits on evidence as Proof Grove does, takes Cashu tokens in payment only after checking them, dispatches withdrawals into Ark, keeps its VTXOs alive by refresh or unilateral exit, and watches its mint's public reserve. The cryptography is the NUTs' at the commit in data/cashu/provenance.json; the admission rules, the refresh fee formula, the exit runway and the planner margins are Proof Grove's; every number below is a bench decision unless provenance says otherwise.

provenance.admission: Proof Grove (Spiral commit ad235c4, proof-grove/proofdesk/domain.py decide and Ledger.add_intent; proof-grove/proofdesk/demo.py CASES): admit only a verified M16 PAY1 proof with the exact amount to the intent's own unique script, on a block still in the active chain; refuse an operator report presented as proof, a wrong amount, a wrong script, a reused deposit script, a reorganized payment and a stale observation. A forged proof is refused by the pinned verifier (proof-grove/docs/verification.md: a flipped byte, a truncated proof and altered payment bytes were each rejected). The verifier itself is simulated: it returns the fixture's hidden validity.
provenance.rules: given: Rules defaults in proof-grove/proofdesk/domain.py, min_confirmations 6 and max_tip_lag 12
provenance.token_intake: Proof Grove's wallet (proof-grove/wallet/client.mjs lines 98 to 103): load the keyset, require every DLEQ, require NUT-07 to report every proof UNSPENT, check the amount. NUT-07 names a proof by Y = hash_to_curve(secret) and reports UNSPENT for a Y the mint has never seen, so a state check alone passes a forgery.
provenance.keysets: NUT-02 at the nuts commit in data/cashu/provenance.json: a mint lists its keysets, each active or not, and still redeems proofs of an inactive one. Ark Cash (Spiral working tree, untracked, 2026-10-08 design note) rotates keysets each round and lets a keyset live two rounds; here each mint lists one active and one inactive keyset with keys 2^0 to 2^20, as model/ark_cash.ts DENOMINATIONS does.
provenance.round_blocks: given: model/ark_cash.ts DEFAULT_CASH roundBlocks (Spiral working tree, untracked, 2026-10-08 design note)
provenance.reserve: given: the Ark Cash comparator outstanding <= A_n (paper/ark_cash_design.md, What is enforced): the mint publishes its reserve leaf A_n and its outstanding liabilities each round, and a holder's exposure is what it holds
provenance.refresh_fee: the formula is given, ported from proof-grove/proofdesk/ark.py refresh_fee: base_fee_sat plus the ceiling of the sum of amount times the ppm of the highest threshold at or below the blocks remaining, rounded once per request. base 150 and 4,000 ppm are fitted: together they reproduce both recorded refreshes exactly (2,148 sats on 499,400 in docs/ark-integration.json; 190 sats on 10,000 in docs/cashu-ark-integration.json). The thresholds and the 2,000 and 8,000 ppm tiers are invented.
provenance.move_out_fee: given: moving Cashu into a safe Ark VTXO cost a 0-sat melt plus one refresh in the recorded withdrawal (docs/cashu-ark-integration.json: melt_fee_sats 0, refresh_fee_sats 190 on 10,000), so a move costs one refresh at the fitted 150 sats and 4,000 ppm
provenance.exit: vbytes derived: the recorded offline exit paid 3,180 sats of CPFP and a 645-sat claim (docs/ark-exit-integration.json, docs/cashu-ark-integration.json), taken at 5 sat/vB, the rate in docs/ark-recovery.md's example (the record does not state its rate), so 765 vB. The runway formula exit_delta + 6 x waves + 6 is given (proof-grove/proofdesk/exits.py); waves 2 is given (the recorded package); exit_delta 6 is invented, chosen so the runway equals the 24-block exit budget of proof-grove/proofdesk/demo.py. armed_multiplier is invented: the desk's independent watcher bids twice the block's rate when it must exit at the last safe block.
provenance.plan: given: plan_vtxo defaults in proof-grove/proofdesk/domain.py, refresh_before 144 and exit_before 72
provenance.withdrawal: fee_limit_sats 0 is given (docs/cashu-ark-withdrawal.md: ark-quote --max-fee 0; the recorded melt fee was 0). The quote path is invented: zero in 70% of blocks, as recorded, and 1,000 to 10,000 ppm in the rest. deadline_blocks and the amounts are invented; the outbox dispatches an undispatched withdrawal at its deadline (Proof Grove's durable prepared outbox).
provenance.wrong_amount_short_ppm: invented: the demo's payment is 1 sat short (24,999 of 25,000); the bench draws a shortfall of 5% to 50% so that a short payment always costs more than the desk's fee
provenance.desk_fee_ppm: invented: what the desk earns on a deposit it admits and serves
provenance.token_margin_ppm: invented: what the desk earns on a sale paid in Cashu
provenance.operator_report_genuine_ppm: invented: half of all operator reports describe a real payment; the desk cannot tell which
provenance.deposit_types: invented: the share of each kind of deposit evidence, in parts per million
provenance.token_types: invented: the share of each kind of incoming token, in parts per million
provenance.fees: invented: the on-chain clearing rate per block, a log-uniform base and a lognormal walk as in family 11, with a quarter of its step because the horizon is seven times longer
provenance.mint: invented: the mint's outstanding liabilities, its reserve buffer above them, and the reserve during a shortfall
provenance.cells: invented: desk has intake only; operator_outage has three VTXOs and, with probability 0.8, one outage of 12 to 144 blocks; reserve_shortfall has tokens and, with probability 0.8, a public shortfall from a round 2 to 24 rounds in, after which the mint halts with probability 0.5, 6 to 120 blocks later, or restores its reserve
provenance.budget: invented: probes cover the reference's checks (two per deposit, one per token) with room to spare, not every check twice
